key_insight: AI can help decode and mitigate instability in 3D inorganic perovskites by linking degradation mechanisms to prediction and design strategies.
engineering_relevance: This framework supports more reliable CsPbX3 devices by guiding material selection, failure diagnosis, and stability-oriented engineering.
evidence_signal: The review highlights major evaluation challenges in the field, including multimodal data, coupled degradation pathways, protocol dependence, sparse statistics, and uncertainty quantification.
watch_item: Current AI studies are limited by inconsistent protocols, weak benchmarks, and poor transferability across domains, which can reduce real-world reliability.
paper_title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
